verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at airwallex.com/llms.txt, and the docs also publish their own llms.txt with .md versions of doc pages. Beyond that, Airwallex ships dedicated machine-oriented "Instructions for AI agents" pages and an unauthenticated Docs MCP for agent documentation lookups, which together cover pointing an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs.
